lock.selectionRule: one shared alpha maximizing validation macro Recall@10; exact ties choose smaller alpha
lock.globalPageRankControl: same alphaStar as PPR; global PageRank NOT independently optimized

settings.graph: positive TRAIN interactions only; binary undirected bipartite; no padding
settings.candidates: all TRAIN movie IDs, including zero-positive-degree movies
settings.aggregation: macro per-user hits / eligible relevant; shared cohort with verified MF scoring
settings.ranking: score DESC; exact ties raw movieId ASC
settings.numericalScheduling: Batch up to32; nonconverged batch column is replayed as WebGL single, then TF.js CPU single only if necessary, always SAME node/alpha/tol1e-6/maxIter500. Every failed attempt and final backend retained; failed CPU replay invalidates the result. No rescaling or tolerance/cap change.
settings.mfCriterion: previous HW5 validation RMSE; checkpoint and scoring unchanged

mf.scoring: clip(mu+dot(P[rawUserId],Q[rawMovieId]),1,5); exact score ties use raw movieId ASC

lock.timingDefinition: Report wall time on the recorded device/backend, including retrieval and cached-scoring paths; MF import is outside the sweep. Not a cross-device speed comparison.
